sentences.text: Your records contain 15 source reports including 6 lab reports dated between 1952-04-22 and 2021-06-11, and no allergies are recorded in the supplied records.

Your records list active conditions including diabetes, hypertriglyceridemia, metabolic syndrome X, anemia, diabetic retinopathy associated with type II diabetes mellitus, neuropathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus, nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus, hyperlipidemia, and macular edema and retinopathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Your records also list viral sinusitis as a previous diagnosis that was recorded on 2019-10-24 and resolved on 2019-11-16.

LDL cholesterol (often called 'bad' cholesterol) was 153 mg/dL on 2021-06-11, which is above the usual range of below 100 mg/dL, and over the last 3 reports between 2020-06-05 and 2021-06-11 it went from 128.5 mg/dL to 126.3 mg/dL and then 153 mg/dL.

SGPT (a liver enzyme) was 59.6 U/L on 2021-04-15, which is above the usual range of 7-40 U/L, and over the last 3 reports between 2019-04-16 and 2021-04-15 it went from 24.4 U/L to 34.7 U/L and then 59.6 U/L.

Triglycerides (a type of blood fat) was 196.5 mg/dL on 2021-06-11, which is above the usual range of below 150 mg/dL, and over the last 3 reports between 2020-06-05 and 2021-06-11 it went from 187.6 mg/dL to 131.4 mg/dL and then 196.5 mg/dL.

HbA1c (average blood sugar over the last few months) was 7 % on 2021-06-11, which is above the usual range of 4-5.6 %, and over the last 3 reports between 2019-11-08 and 2021-06-11 it stayed at 7 % to 7 % and then 7 %.

Total cholesterol was 237.5 mg/dL on 2021-06-11, which is above the usual range of below 200 mg/dL, and over the last 3 reports between 2020-06-05 and 2021-06-11 it went from 213.7 mg/dL to 173.4 mg/dL and then 237.5 mg/dL.

Blood sugar (glucose) was 100.2 mg/dL on 2021-06-11, which is above the usual range of 70-99 mg/dL, and over the last 3 reports between 2020-06-05 and 2021-06-11 it went from 105.7 mg/dL to 109.1 mg/dL and then 100.2 mg/dL.
The rest of the test results in your records did not raise an alert.
Blood-pressure screening is normal, with the latest reading of 110/84 on 2021-06-11 being below 140/90.
Anaemia screening is normal, and your haemoglobin of 15.7 g/dL is at or above 13 g/dL.

Your records list ongoing medications including Simvastatin 10 MG Oral Tablet since 2008-04-18, Fluticasone propionate 0.044 MG/ACTUAT Metered Dose Inhaler since 1952-04-22, and Albuterol 0.09 MG/ACTUAT Metered Dose Inhaler since 1952-04-22.

sections.title: Points to discuss with your doctor

sentences.text: You may want to ask your doctor about your LDL cholesterol, SGPT, triglycerides, HbA1c, total cholesterol, and blood sugar results.
You can also discuss your ongoing conditions and how to monitor your overall wellness during your visits.
